main_text.p: ctatus fuit Dominus; sed fideliter & pie se exercentibus in opere Divinitus pręscripto. Praxis fidei, resipiscentię, gratitudinis, novæ obedientiæ, prorsus necessaria fuit. Qui sic observârunt Sabbathum, habuerunt argumentum sanctificationis Divinæ; quòd ipsi verè essent populus Deo sanctus, eique in promisso & exspectato Messiâ gratus atque acceptus. Sic Notę Belgicæ ad Ezech. xx, 12. Dat ick de HEERE ben / diese heylige. Dat is/ upt genade affonderen van andere men=schen/ op dat ick haer Godt zy/ ende sy mijn volck/ het welck ick my door het bloet des Messiae regnige/ ende door mijn Woordt ende Geest heyligh ma=ke.

4. Israëlitæ fideles verè fuerunt justificati & sanctificati in Christo; licet non consummati sine nobis, sive seorsim à nobis; Hebr. xi, 40. Unicâ enim oblatione consummavit in perpetuum eos qui sanctificantur. Cap. x, 14. Alioquin oportuisset eum sæpè passum fuisse à jacto mundi fundamento; sed nunc semel in consummatione sæculorum, ad peccatum per immolationem sui ipsius è medio tollendum, factus est manifestus.

page.notes: The black letter passage is Dutch, set in Fraktur; several words are doubtful because of the small scan and are not marked individually. The Latin first line of the page is a fragment continuing from the previous page. Some ink spots in the upper margin are not text.
